name: session_id
description: was_request_id, '-S' and the session number, e.g. WAS-11-S2.

name: was_request_id
description: WAS- and the Participant ID, or WAS-row and the Excel row when the ID is blank.

name: employer_id
description: The employer (dim_employer), or NULL when the source row names none.

name: session_number
description: The session's number, from [[was.sessions]] in config.toml.

name: session_date
description: When the session was held. NULL when it has details but no date; such sessions don't count as held.

name: duration
description: Duration mapped by mappings/was_duration.csv, or as typed when unmapped.

name: summary_sent_date
description: When the session summary was sent.

name: topics
description: The session's mapped topics, joined with '; '.
